purpose: Assemble one evidence-backed launch-readiness package across message, product flow, measurement, and optional channel capabilities without launching.

objective_signals: The objective concerns launch readiness, release communication, acquisition readiness, or coordinated channel preparation.
prerequisites: The launch objective and expected user path are defined; feedback-only and acquisition launches may use different gates.

nodes.objective: Define one launch goal, user path, scope, owners, readiness criteria, non-goals, and stop rule.
Collect current evidence about audience, alternatives, channel constraints, and launch risks.
Assess whether the intended user path reaches the promised value and identify blocking funnel gaps.
Bind launch baseline, metrics, guardrails, window, coverage, and decision rule.

nodes.run_when: Run when owned-web or search discovery is part of the launch motion.
nodes.objective: Prepare the technical and content discoverability preflight without changing or publishing the website.

nodes.run_when: Run only when a consented lifecycle journey is part of the expected user path.
nodes.objective: Prepare a paused lifecycle journey with consent, suppression, frequency, and measurement checks.

nodes.run_when: Run when final launch assets are required by the selected channels.
nodes.objective: Produce a revision-bound creative package with rights, accessibility, metadata, and exact hashes.
Assemble the supported narrative, readiness findings, channel sequence, risks, and explicit no-launch boundary.
Review the exact launch-readiness package and assets for truth, evidence, readiness, rights, authority, and no-publication compliance.
